evals.prompt: Build an agent-based model of residential segregation where agents relocate if too few neighbors share their group, and show what emerges.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-abm-mesa: builds a Schelling-style Mesa 3 model (Agent + Model, super().__init__(seed=...), agents.shuffle_do('step'), a grid), collects the segregation outcome, and reports emergence across replications — using the current Mesa 3 API, not removed mesa.time schedulers.

assertions.value: Builds a Mesa 3 ABM with the AgentSet scheduling API and reports emergent macro behavior, not a single run.

evals.prompt: I have an opinion-dynamics agent model on a network and want to sweep the influence parameter to find where consensus breaks down.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-abm-mesa: uses mesa.batch_run to sweep the parameter across iterations, and interprets the emergent consensus/polarization outcome as a function of the parameter (tipping point).

evals.prompt: Simulate the diffusion of an innovation through a population of interacting agents and measure adoption over time.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-abm-mesa: builds interacting agents with a local adoption rule, collects adoption via the DataCollector, and validates with replications rather than a single trajectory.

assertions.value: Constructs a Mesa agent model of diffusion and validates the emergent adoption curve across seeds.

evals.prompt: Model a hospital emergency room as a queueing system where patients wait for a limited number of doctors and I track waiting times.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-simpy. A queueing / discrete-event process simulation is SimPy's domain, not an agent-based emergence model.

evals.prompt: I want to train an agent to learn an optimal policy in an environment using reinforcement learning.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-stable-baselines3. Learning an optimal policy is reinforcement learning, not generative agent-based social simulation.
